description.sub_name: 工程設計與設備智能化整合
description.sub_ename: INTELLIGENT INTEGRATION OF ENGINEERING DESIGN AND EQUIPMENT
description.describe_ch: 虛實整合之數位製造技術是先進製造能力與數位化、智慧化科技的融合與協同合作。其應用貫穿產品全生命週期，包括設計、生產、售後服務等各產品價值創造環節。為實現設計與生產優化，導入具虛實整合之數位技術，逐漸成為智慧製造(ex.橡塑膠)產業與智能化設備(ex.智能化射出機)發展與應用趨勢。
description.describe_eh: Digital manufacturing technologies are the integration and collaboration of cyber-physical system and advanced manufacturing which runs through the entire product life cycle, including design, production, after-sales service and other product value creation. In order to achieve design and production optimization, digital technology with cyber-physical integration has gradually become the development and application trend of smart machines (injection machine) and smart manufacturing industries.

targets.describe_ch: 塑膠高分子材料、異材質材料、塑性加工製程與產品成型之細部設計與相關規格表介紹。
targets.describe_en: Detailed design and related specification sheets introduction of polymer/heterogeneous materials, plastic processing processes and product molding.

targets.describe_ch: 掌握材料應用於流體與熱力學領域及其製程，以及與加工參數設定與機台感測數據的科學意義。
targets.describe_en: Master the fields of materials on fluids and thermodynamics and their manufacturing processes, as well as the scientific influences on processing parameter settings and machine response data.

targets.describe_ch: 掌握材料應用於塑性加工與工程力學分析系統，以及如何進行試模。
targets.describe_en: Master the application of materials to plastic processing and engineering mechanics analysis systems, and how to test molds.

targets.describe_ch: 產品設計與成型條件之優化調整，以及機台感測數據資料的取得與判讀。
targets.describe_en: Adjustment of product design and molding conditions, as well as acquisition and interpretation of machine sensing data.

targets.describe_ch: 透過智能化方法或實驗逐步進行成型條件調整，以及相關條件的修改設定協助系統建置。
targets.describe_en: Step by step adjustment of molding conditions through intelligent methods or experiments to assist system construction.
